newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Profits, U.K. buy boost QBE shares.
newsitem.headline: Profits, U.K. buy boost QBE shares.

text.p: Shares in QBE Insurances Ltd scaled new heights to reach a record high of A$7.94 on Friday as investors bought in, buoyed by the company's strong profit result and bonus issue and today's purchase of a U.K. reinsurance company, brokers said.

On September 2, the company reported a 78.5 percent higher full year net profit of A$147.3 million and a one for four bonus issue, while earlier today it announced the purchase of the U.K. reinsurance operations of U.S. insurance group, Allstate Corp, for A$70 million.

"They have had a very good result plus the bonus issue," said dealer Hamish Bonifant of Lance Jones, adding that the profit result had been analysed and recommendations were now finding their way to brokers' clients.
"People have delved into the figures and investors are now reacting to that," he said.
Noting the U.K. purchase, Bonifant said the company had already flagged its interest in further acquisitions.
"They have signalled that they have money to spend and they have bought what looks like good assets," he said.
By 1.30 p.m. (0330 GMT), QBE shares were 15 cents at A$7.95 on turnover of 148,911 shares.
